verdict.rationale: Brave documents dedicated vertical endpoints for news (real-time news with its own news_search API reference and country parameter), images (with filtering and SafeSearch), video, and local/place search. The official llms.txt and MCP server confirm web, image, video and news search as separate services. Finance is covered only indirectly, through the Rich Search API's 'stocks' vertical, which is driven by query intent and sourced from third-party providers. Missing for 10: a dedicated finance endpoint or detailed documentation of finance data and category filters, and independent hands-on corroboration of vertical endpoint quality.
